decision: Full training is justified as an independent source-matched PyTorch reproduction attempt; no numerical paper result has been reproduced by this smoke run.

architecture.reference: TensorFlow v1.4 BasicLSTMCell equations, i,j,f,o gate order and forget_bias=1; pinned author decoder dense/activation/XOR structure. Independent NumPy forward with same weights, dropout disabled.

findings_fixed_before_scaling: Validation checkpoint and seed selection now minimize fitted error per cycle, rather than pooled wrong count.
Point/boot fit bounds match original executable source, including positional-argument bug that leaves validation t0 bound at10.
Probability=.5 predicts odd parity, matching source.
Adam resets at each epoch to match source graph rebuilding for longer validation histories.
Adam epsilon placement matches original TensorFlow formula.
known_disclosed_differences: PyTorch replaces TensorFlow1 contrib; same architecture/equations checked, not bitwise identical hardware/runtime.
New seeds and batched float32 NumPy uniform draws replace original float64 RandomState trajectories; exact supplied-fault circuit equivalence checked separately.
Training seeds share the newly frozen data; original datasets and trained weights unavailable.
1000 whole-trajectory bootstrap resamples instead of author source default5000.
Only Figure3 Pauli-circuit LSTM target; no fresh blossom/MWPM implementation or density-matrix model.
limits: Smoke fit is not a scientific result: its first epoch reaches t0 upper bound, expected for an untrained decoder and128 validation examples.
Full production must satisfy100 epochs without improved fitted validation error for all3 seeds; no arbitrary shorter cap.
Validate final curve/fit quality and confidence interval before claiming numerical reproduction.
MPS behavior is not validated by this CPU-only check.
